definitions: To cut short the hair, wool, or fur of an animal.
To remove the top part of a plant or tree.
To produce or yield a harvest.
To appear or emerge unexpectedly (often with 'up').
To cut or edit an image to remove unwanted parts.
examples: The farmer will crop the sheep's wool.
We need to crop the hedges.
The fields crop well this year.
New problems crop up all the time.
I'll crop the photo to focus on your face.
